# netbox_saved_filter (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/customization/savedfilter/):

> A saved filter stores a set of filter parameters for a list view, to be reused or shared.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_saved_filter" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `object_types` (Set of String)
- `parameters` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `shared` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `slug` (String)
- `user_id` (Number)
- `weight` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
